description: This file contains a test class 'TestLazyONNXPackages' that verifies lazy import behavior of certain ONNX-related packages using subprocess calls in a temporary directory. It uses internal testing utilities 'common_utils' from 'torch.testing._internal' and custom 'pytorch_test_common'.

classes.name: TestLazyONNXPackages
classes.description: A test case class that checks whether 'onnxruntime' and 'onnxscript' packages are lazily imported when importing 'torch.onnx'.

methods.name: _test_package_is_lazily_imported(self, pkg, torch_pkg="torch.onnx")
methods.description: A helper method that runs a subprocess to import 'torch.onnx' with import timing enabled and asserts that the specified package is not imported (to ensure lazy import).

methods.name: test_onnxruntime_is_lazily_imported(self)
methods.description: Test method that verifies 'onnxruntime' is lazily imported.

methods.name: test_onnxscript_is_lazily_imported(self)
methods.description: Test method that verifies 'onnxscript' is lazily imported.
